description: Fetch a key's metadata by its key id — name, owner, permissions, credits, rate limits and whether it is enabled. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.getKey.

decrypt.description: Also return the plaintext secret. Only works for keys created as recoverable.

keyId.description: The key's id (key_...), NOT the secret key itself.

name: unkey_get_key
title: Get one key by id
